description: Tests whether two categorical variables are associated using the chi-square statistic. Returns observed and expected contingency tables, chi-square statistic, p-value, and Cramér's V effect size. Use to test association between Pell status and retention, major and career outcome, or any two categorical variables.

row_column.description: First categorical variable (rows of contingency table)

col_column.description: Second categorical variable (columns of contingency table)

weight_column.description: Optional numeric weight column (for pre-aggregated data)
